scenario: dsc.rete does not lower a `fact::Json` cast (it has no defined shape), so dsc.driver refuses the rule with DS_VALIDATE_RULE_NOT_LOWERED (RLOW.1.6) instead of writing an artefact without it. LCST.4.5.2 states `fact -> Json` as a total conversion: any fact-typed source converts to Json, here `emit Out payload: s::Json` where s is a pattern binding (total, no `?`).
rules_ds:
schema Sample scope logical:
    x: String key

schema Out scope ttl 1_h:
    payload: Json

rule r:
    Sample s
->
    emit Out payload: s::Json
